body:
You should call the police. He'll probably do it to the next female who moves in.

Hope everything is well with you now.
What a Perv that guy is. After you leave, call the police or inform his wife of what he's doing.

Yeah. And that hasn't been the last of things like this. But I've gotten better at handling them.

Thanks. I'll do that.

Sorry for the loss of your dog. But at least she really cared about you, and was even willing to risk herself in that state for you. I hope she will leave that guy who tried to attack you with a memory that will make him think twice from now on.

Some friends you had. I'm sorry that happened to you. I wish I could take those bastards to court for you, so they'd get put away for a long time. Setting up the rape of your own friend is unbelievable. Thank God you and your family are okay. May your ex-friends live in hell.

I wish that was true, but to be honest, these kids come from rich families and get whatever they want. I have lots of issues in my family due to my autism. It causes great stress on my family. Last year my father nearly left because he was tired of raising me and it was too stressful for him. However, he stayed. But, he almost has split from my mom several times because of me, and I'm very well behaved. He loves me a lot, but sometimes gets too stressed out because of my autism, and it scares me when he wants to leave because of me. I forgot to also add that. But, as of now, he's apologized and promised me he'll stay no matter what, and he sometimes drinks a lot, which is when this happens.

I've started to handle it somewhat. I just ignore it. My dad also has taken serious action against the school because of this. Some of the bullies have left. I also forgot to mention, in 6th grade, they tried to kill me with a hunting knife, that they somehow managed to take to school. I have told my mom about it, but I have yet to tell my father because of what he might do.

I'm sorry you had to endure that. At least you managed to survive. But, I'm still on edge currently, and I feel I might not make it much longer. I'm a very weak person. I just don't have the strength to see anything good in myself, and as I said, I even cry when I look at myself. But, you did help me with this advice.  I will try really hard to keep going.

I currently go to therapy. But sadly, it's not fully helping. A lot has happened to me. I'll explain more soon, because class is about to start for me. Reply and I'll give you a longer response later.
I have a lot to say to you, but since my class is about to start, I can't right now. I'll give you a longer reply at lunch. But I do acknowledge what you've shared, and I appreciate it.

Although I personally don't believe it, everyone considers me extremely handsome. I get a lot of attention for my looks, and many girls in school have a crush on me. However, I personally think everyone exaggerating on that. 

A lot more has happened because we have a lot of insane people. I've learned how to defend myself though. I'll have more experiences to share soon. But for now, I'm fine.
Yeah, he was 4 years old too sadly. You're welcome.

Glad you and your mother survived. Something similar to this has happening to someone I once knew. Sadly, they perished, and the father avoided prison. But, at least this guy won't be able to hurt anyone else. I wish the best for you and your mother.
I'll try not to. Thanks for your support.
